component.name: LemonWatch
component.summary: Instant workspace cache scanner and purger

description.p: LemonWatch is a fast, native desktop GUI for scanning development workspaces and reclaiming disk space from stale build caches. It detects projects by their markers (package.json, Cargo.toml, pyproject.toml, go.mod, composer.json, .git) and lists reclaimable cache directories such as node_modules, .next, target, .venv, __pycache__, vendor, and more.

Features include multi-threaded scanning with rayon, ecosystem badges (Node, Rust, Python, Go), dormancy detection (last-active timestamps), safe one-click purge with confirmation and progress, and a CLI mode with --dry-run and --json.
